$comment: Feature switches each feature needs on lms-test.enara.app (Vercel project enara-lms-test, Production). Before every deploy the pipeline (deploy/lms-test/cli.mjs apply-flags) creates the ones that are missing and corrects the ones that differ, as plain variables. It never removes a variable and never touches a Sensitive one. Only switch names are allowed here (LMS_*, ENROLLMENT_*, GRADE_LEDGER_*, MAINTENANCE_ENDPOINTS_*, MOODLE_TEST_WS_*; nothing that looks like a key, token, password or address). A feature PR adds its own entry. test.enara.app is frozen: this file is for lms-test only. docs/lms/CONTINUOUS_DELIVERY.md

features.name: LMS Phase 2: activity picker (LTI Deep Linking)
LMS Phase 3: grades to the LMS (AGS)
LMS Phase 8: tutor, live avatar and diagnostic activities (no grade)
Test-site maintenance routes (migrations and the deploy health check)

notManaged.$comment: Read by people only. Switches that exist but are NOT set by the pipeline, with the reason. Move one into features only with the owner's OK.
